conversion.intermediate: 16-bit FLAC at the original 48 kHz stereo rate
conversion.crc: CRC-8 polynomial 0x07, initial zero, cumulative per 1024 stream bytes including final short chunk
conversion.stereo: Preserve original left/right channels, resampling each with identical filter timing
conversion.resampler: Second Reality 512-phase 100 dB Kaiser-windowed sinc, sequential evaluation; floating-point output retained until normalization to prevent filter-overshoot clipping
conversion.normalization: One constant shared gain after resampling and before quantization; target -1 dBFS; validate decoded EBU R128 true peak <= -1 dBTP; reduce by excess plus 0.1 dB and re-encode, at most five attempts
conversion.true_peak_meter: FFmpeg EBU R128; upper bounds include 0.0005 linear metadata rounding margin
conversion.packing: One byte per stereo frame: low nibble left, high nibble right; codebook pairs contain left 48 bytes then right 48 bytes; even frame-count segments
conversion.reconstruction: Independent signed 16-bit saturating delta accumulators, reset together at the song loop

tool_source.note: Original source hashes identify the imported Second Reality algorithms and remain unchanged. The local encoder extends them with DLT3 independent stereo codebooks, floating resampling, shared normalization and decoded true-peak validation; conversion.encoder_files_sha256 identifies the implementation used for this asset.
